Q: This is the adjuster recording a statement regarding the parking lot collision in Katy, Texas. Please state your full
name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving slowly thorugh the lot of a shopping center, looking for an open space near the entrance. It was busy,
with cars backing out all over the place.
Q: What happened next?
A: A silver sedan backed out from a space on my left and didn't stop. I hit the brakes hard, but the front of my car
clipped the rear quarter panel of theirs. It wasn't a high-speed impact, but it was enough to throw me against the
steering wheel and jerk my arms.
Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?
A: My right wrist hurt right away, and I was sore in the shoulder. I didn't think much of it until the next morning, when
the wrist was swollen and I couldn't grip anything.
Q: Have you seen a dcotor since the collision?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic, and they took X-rays. The doctor told me the wrist was fractured and put me in
a splint. I'm scheduled to see an orthopedic specialist for follow-up.
Q: Did you get the other driver's information?
A: Yes, I exchanged insurance details and took a few photos of both vehicles before we moved them.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Not that I can think of. I just want to get my car repaired and get my wrist healed so I can get back to work.
Q: Thnak you. That concludes the statement.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
